# GitHub Dark

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-dark)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-dark)

GitHub Dark is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the GitHub family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-dark codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `githubDark` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { githubDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-dark';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, githubDark],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `githubDark` | `Extension` |
| `githubDarkMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#0d1117` |
| Active line | `#10141b` |
| Selection | `#032f56` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#ff7b72` | bold | 7.51:1 | 7.32:1 | 5.39:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#ff7b72` | bold | 7.51:1 | 7.32:1 | 5.39:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#c9d1d9` | - | 12.26:1 | 11.96:1 | 8.81:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#8d96a0` | - | 6.31:1 | 6.15:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#79c0ff` | - | 9.73:1 | 9.49:1 | 6.99:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#79c0ff` | - | 9.73:1 | 9.49:1 | 6.99:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#7ee787` | - | 12.32:1 | 12.01:1 | 8.85:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#d2a8ff` | - | 9.72:1 | 9.48:1 | 6.98:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ff7b72` | - | 7.51:1 | 7.32:1 | 5.39:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#d2a8ff` | italic | 9.72:1 | 9.48:1 | 6.98:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#79c0ff` | italic | 9.73:1 | 9.49:1 | 6.99:1 |
| String | `string` | `#a5d6ff` | - | 12.31:1 | 12.01:1 | 8.84:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#a5d6ff` | - | 12.31:1 | 12.01:1 | 8.84:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#ffab70` | - | 10.19:1 | 9.94:1 | 7.32:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#ffab70` | - | 10.19:1 | 9.94:1 | 7.32:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#79c0ff` | - | 9.73:1 | 9.49:1 | 6.99:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#8d96a0` | italic | 6.31:1 | 6.15:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#8d96a0` | - | 6.31:1 | 6.15:1 | 4.53:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#c9d1d9` | background, active line, selection | 8.81:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#8d96a0` | gutter | 5.77:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ffffff` | background, active line | 18.45:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#58a6ff` | background | 7.49:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #4d90fe` | background, active line | 5.92:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#4d90fe, 1px solid #79c0ff` | background (fill or outline) | 9.73:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#032f56` | active line | 1.36:1 | Pass |
